description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Extracts all hyperlinks from any public webpage. Returns href URLs normalized to absolute URLs with visible link text. Filters out javascript:, mailto:, data: schemes. Optionally restrict to same-domain links, deduplicate, or include #anchor links. Useful for crawlers, sitemap builders, link graph analysis, and content audits.
